business.who_fixes_things: Priya, a freelance developer, two days a month, not on retainer
business.how_maya_finds_out_today: Someone tells her. Usually a customer, sometimes her bookkeeper.

routines_touched.what_maya_calls_it: Stock moving between the counter and the website
routines_touched.in_her_words: Everything is in one pile. If someone buys the last lamp in the shop the website has to know within the hour or I sell it twice and have to write to somebody and apologise. It goes the other way too when we move a pallet up from the unit.
routines_touched.if_it_stops: Nothing looks wrong. The website keeps selling. I find out when two people have bought the same thing.
routines_touched.how_late_would_she_notice: a few days, when the second customer complains
routines_touched.what_it_costs: A refund, an apology, and a review. In December it is worse because the counter is busy and nobody is watching the numbers.
